guitar.notes: Corrected: Kim Thayil is Soundgarden's guitarist; Chris Cornell was primarily vocalist (occasionally rhythm guitar) so listing him as co-equal guitarist overstates his role. Kim Thayil's Guild S-100 is reasonably well documented.

tone.target: dark grunge fuzz-crunch with thick mids and tight attack
tone.profile: dark grunge fuzz-crunch with thick mids and tight attack
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing Fuzz distortion into a British stack (UK 45) with a vintage cabinet, emphasizing mid-range thickness and tight attack.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain fuzz tones.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage for aggressive attack.
blocks.gap: The target requires more pure fuzz than a standard OD, but Green OD provides necessary mid-range punch before the main distortion.

alternatives.reason: Could provide similar grit but might lack the aggressive midrange focus.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core dark grunge fuzz tone and thick saturation.

alternatives.reason: Could be used for a different type of psychedelic grit, but 'Fuzz' is better suited for the thick grunge sound.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall-style gain and punchy British tone required for grunge.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is a good proxy, but modern grunge often requires more aggressive saturation than this amp model provides on its own.

alternatives.reason: Might be too clean or focused on classic rock rather than heavy fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall-style cabinet sound and necessary punchy frequency response.
Sculpt the tone by boosting mids and slightly rolling off bass/treble to achieve thick midrange focus.
Included as a placeholder; kept inactive to avoid unwanted modulation and maintain dry alt-rock feel.
blocks.gap: The target explicitly avoids heavy chorus, so this module is bypassed but included for completeness.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle, dry room ambience to give the 90s alt-rock feel without sounding overly wet.
blocks.gap: The target asks for 'dry/roomy,' so careful settings are needed. Room reverb is better than Plate or Spring here.

alternatives.reason: Might sound too bright or artificial for the grunge context.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and grit matching the grunge era.
